audit_scope.description: Batch 11 processes EL internal operations including precompiled contract dispatch, EVM opcodes, and protocol mechanisms. Most subgraphs focus on purely internal EVM operations with minimal external interaction.

in_scope: Precompiled contract address mapping and dispatch
out_of_scope: External transaction submission (covered in other batches)

misclassified_entities.reason: Calling contract or EOA is internal EVM execution context, not external to the Execution Layer system boundary.

trusted_external_entities.name: Users via Transactions - EVM Execution Trigger
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users submit signed transactions that trigger EVM execution including precompile calls and opcode execution. Transaction data (to address, calldata, value) is untrusted and must be validated. Smart contract code execution is deterministic but input-driven, requiring validation of all external inputs.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Transaction signature must be valid. Nonce must match account nonce. Gas limit must be sufficient and not exceed block gas limit. Value transfer must not exceed account balance. Destination address determines execution path (EOA vs contract vs precompile). All EVM operations must respect gas limits and consensus rules.

coverage_gaps.reason: Batch 11 subgraphs are primarily internal EVM operations with limited external entity interactions. Most operations are purely computational (opcode execution, precompile dispatch) with no direct external data ingestion beyond the initial transaction trigger.
